Implement Jira ticket {{JIRA_TICKET}} using automatic sdd. When you start, if the ticket status is "READY FOR DEVELOP", move the task to the "IN PROGRESS" column; otherwise abort process. If the process is aborted, or phases verify or code-review give a FAIL veredict, you MUST move the ticket to "DEVELOPMENT FAILED". You MUST always add the final verdict as comment of the ticket.
